name: Providence Portland Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at Providence Portland Medical Center. Greet and guide visitors, help in support departments or help in clinical areas, and make the hospital a better place for patients.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be at least 16 years old.
duration: At least 6 months in a row, usually 2 to 4 hours a week
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Apply any time; staff match applicants to open spots.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply to Volunteer link on the page. Volunteer Services reviews your availability and interests and contacts you. If accepted, onboarding takes about 3 to 4 weeks with a background check, a health screening and an in-person orientation.
notes: Volunteer Services phone: 503-215-5002. The page does not list teen-only roles, so ask which spots take 16 and 17 year olds.
